voronoi_cells — SEGMENTATION world op

• Data kinds: points → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.voronoi_cells(seeds, size) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segworld; segworld.voronoi_cells(seeds, size) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("voronoi_cells"))

Usage

Voronoi partition of seeds inside a rectangle, returned as polygons with areas and internal edge lengths (brute-force half-planes, O(n^2)) (voronoi_cells).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値: polygons(多角形の列、各 (k, 2) [y, x])、areas(靴紐)、edge_length_total(内部の辺の長さの和)、n_edges(内部の辺の数)、perimeter_internal (n,)(各セルの内部の辺の長さ)。
